Forvis Mazars, Malta: parking-rate of 12% VAT introduced by Legal Notice 231/2023 with effect from 1 January 2024
Deloitte Malta: Budget 2011 update - accommodation reduced rate 5% to 7% from 1 January 2011
businesspress VAT records: Malta standard rate changed from 15% to 18% on 1 January 2004
Tax Foundation: 2022 VAT Rates in Europe (table as of January 2022, sourced from the European Commission's Taxes in Europe Database)

caveats: individualTaxYear is the calendar year, inferred from the country's annual assessment cycle (grade I); not confirmed on the authority's own pages in this pass.
companyYearEndDefault is a 31 December app default for new entities (grade I), not a statutory requirement; companies may choose other year ends under national law.
The authority site (cfr.gov.mt) was blocked to automated fetches this session; rates rest on the Commission's table.

Effective dates: 18% standard from 1 January 2004 and the 7% accommodation rate from 1 January 2011 are secondary-sourced (budget records); the 12% parking rate (custody and securities management, third-party credit management, short-term pleasure-boat hire, non-therapeutic body care) entered into force on 1 January 2024 under Legal Notice 231/2023.

Lower-bound rows - reduced (2022-01-01): the `from` date is the earliest a source confirms the rate applied, not necessarily its true start (confirmed applying on 1 January 2022 by the Tax Foundation's January 2022 table of VAT rates (sourced from the Commission's Taxes in Europe Database)).
